notes: Performance - Specifications, printed page ii: MAXIMUM WEIGHT Ramp 2558 POUNDS, Takeoff 2550 POUNDS, Landing 2550 POUNDS; STANDARD EMPTY WEIGHT 1663 POUNDS; MAXIMUM USEFUL LOAD 895 POUNDS.
The handbook computes maximum useful load against maximum ramp weight (2558 lb), not maximum takeoff weight (2550 lb): 2558 - 1663 = 895.
Standard empty weight is the handbook figure for a standard-equipped airplane. Each airplane's own weighed basic empty weight, from its weight-and-balance record, governs.
corrections_applied: FD-760 (2026-09-26): empty_weight 1672 -> 1663 and useful_load 878 -> 895. The previous figures cited no handbook.

takeoff_ground_roll_provenance.title: Short Field Takeoff Distance
takeoff_ground_roll_provenance.conditions: Flaps 10 deg, full throttle prior to brake release, paved level dry runway, zero wind
notes: Short field technique as specified in Section 4.
Above 3000 ft elevation, lean the mixture to maximum RPM in a full throttle static runup.
Decrease distances 10% for each 9 knots headwind. For tailwinds up to 10 knots, increase distances 10% for each 2 knots.
For operation on dry grass runway, increase distances by 15% of the ground roll figure.
